Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F02
Accountable role (person not assigned): Backend engineer

Outcome: Reference and PostgreSQL catalogs support durable organizational records and controlled administration.

Acceptance:
- Add checked migrations and application contracts for labs/projects, membership, project dataset placement and human-readable metadata; preserve existing release IDs and attribution.
- Migrate old curator/dataset records explicitly and provide audited stewardship transfer; no default public workspace or accidental access widening.
- Prove reference/PostgreSQL agreement, concurrent updates, authorized administration, upgrade preservation and denial of unauthorized membership changes.

Evidence anchors:
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/Capabilities.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresDatabase.scala

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: F02: Persist governed labs, projects and memberships
